name: Guide
spawnCondition: Present in every new world from the start.
quotes: You should stay indoors at night. It is very dangerous to be wandering around in the dark.
If you show me an item, I can tell you what you can make with it.
description: The Guide greets every new adventurer. Show him any material and he lists every recipe it belongs to.
notes: Throwing his Guide Voodoo Doll into Underworld lava summons the Wall of Flesh.

name: Merchant
spawnCondition: Arrives when all players combined hold 50 silver coins or more.
services: Sells basic tools, torches, and arrows
description: Sells everyday essentials. A reliable early source of torches, arrows, and the Bug Net for bait.

name: Nurse
spawnCondition: Arrives after you use your first Life Crystal (200 max HP).
services: Full heal for a coin fee
description: Instantly restores your health and cures debuffs — for a price. Boss-fight insurance, if you can reach her mid-fight.

name: Demolitionist
spawnCondition: Arrives once you have an explosive in your inventory.
description: Loves loud noises. Explosives are the fastest way to dig shafts and demolish obstacles.

name: Arms Dealer
spawnCondition: Arrives once you have a bullet-firing gun in your inventory.
description: Your one-stop shop for guns, bullets, and later some of the strongest ranged weapons.

name: Dryad
spawnCondition: Arrives after any boss is defeated.
description: Guardian of the world's natural balance. Ask her about the status of Corruption, Crimson, and Hallow spread.

name: Painter
spawnCondition: Arrives after three other town NPCs have moved in.
description: Sells every color of paint for personalizing your builds.

name: Dye Trader
spawnCondition: Arrives once you have a dye-related item or a Strange Plant.
description: Trades dyes to recolor your armor and accessories.

name: Stylist
spawnCondition: Rescued from a Web-covered cocoon in a Spider Cave.
description: Found tangled in cobwebs underground. Changes your hairstyle and color for free.

name: Goblin Tinkerer
spawnCondition: Rescued after a Goblin Army invasion, found Bound underground.
description: Reforges your gear for random stat bonuses (or curses) and sells the Tinkerer's Workshop for accessory crafting.

name: Mechanic
spawnCondition: Rescued from the Dungeon after defeating Skeletron.
description: Unlocks Terraria's wiring system — the heart of automated farms, traps, and secret doors.

name: Witch Doctor
spawnCondition: Arrives after the Queen Bee is defeated.
description: A Jungle-dwelling mystic. Sells summoner equipment and, at night in Hardmode, powerful wings.

name: Clothier
spawnCondition: Freed after Skeletron is defeated (the cursed Old Man).
description: The Old Man, freed from his curse. Sells vanity outfits and drops the Clothier Voodoo Doll.

name: Angler
spawnCondition: Found sleeping at an Ocean, on the shore or in the water.
description: Hands out daily fishing quests. Completing them earns fishing gear, potions, and the Cell Phone ingredients.

name: Zoologist
spawnCondition: Arrives after you fill 10% of the Bestiary.
description: A bestiary enthusiast. Sell her creatures and buy critter-related equipment and mounts.

name: Golfer
spawnCondition: Found in the Underground Desert.
description: A laid-back golfer hiding in the Underground Desert. Sells everything you need for Terraria golf.

name: Tavernkeep
spawnCondition: Found unconscious after the Eater of Worlds or Brain of Cthulhu is defeated.
services: Sells sentry summon weapons & Defender Medals rewards
description: Runs the Old One's Army event. Spend Defender Medals on sentry weapons and his unique forge.

name: Party Girl
spawnCondition: Randomly arrives once you have a certain number of NPCs.
description: Brings the party wherever she goes, selling confetti, fireworks, and party gear.

name: Pirate
spawnCondition: Arrives after the Pirate Invasion is defeated.
description: A salty sea dog who sells cannons and pirate gear after you repel the Pirate Invasion.

name: Steampunker
spawnCondition: Arrives in Hardmode after a mechanical boss is defeated.
description: The key to controlling world evil. Her Clentaminator and solutions spread or cleanse biomes.

name: Cyborg
spawnCondition: Arrives in Hardmode after Plantera is defeated.
description: A robot vendor selling rockets and advanced launchers late in Hardmode.

name: Tax Collector
spawnCondition: Purified from a Tortured Soul in the Underworld.
description: Gathers a small amount of coins from your other town NPCs. Passive income, literally.

name: Truffle
spawnCondition: Moves into a house in a surface Glowing Mushroom biome (Hardmode).
description: A sentient mushroom who only settles in a surface Glowing Mushroom biome. Sells the Autohammer for Shroomite.

name: Santa Claus
spawnCondition: Arrives during the Frost Legion-adjacent Christmas season (after Frost Legion).
description: A seasonal visitor who sells holiday items while Christmas lasts.

name: Princess
spawnCondition: Arrives once every other town NPC has moved in.
description: The final town NPC. She loves every biome and sells a collection of unique royal items.

name: Travelling Merchant
spawnCondition: Randomly visits during the day if enough NPCs are present.
description: A wandering merchant with a random inventory of rare items. Always worth checking when he shows up.

name: Skeleton Merchant
spawnCondition: Randomly found deep underground; despawns if you leave.
description: A friendly skeleton trading underground. Sells Glowsticks and other cave essentials.
